fires.name: Alexander_Trail_Fire
fires.model_caveat: arrival_run chosen for best RECALL among the six FlameFlux v3 candidates on the production-valid t0-window corpus (R=0.624 on the fc2 held-out fires, R=0.432 on Dillon -- see candidate_comparison.md from the 2026-07-24 comparison). It does NOT meet the project's P>=0.50/R>=0.80 target: precision is the WORST of the six (P=0.120 on fc2 -- most flagged growth is wrong), and wind_run actually edges it on F1. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: arrival_run trained on the leaky 'observed' corpus (crop centered/sized on t0|t1, i.e. it saw the future perimeter's geometry during training) and has NEVER seen a t0-window crop -- the ONLY geometry this live pipeline can ever produce at forecast time (the future perimeter is, by definition, unknown). So every live prediction from this model is out-of-distribution relative to its own training. The measured t0-window numbers above already reflect that (they are not a surprise), but this is 'best available', not 'production-ready' -- represent it that way. The operating_point (floor=0.0, mult=0.9) is the VAL-selected connected-causal decode point; it did NOT clear the 0.50 precision floor during selection (feasible=False, val P=0.270/R=0.259) -- it's the best-F1 fallback point, not a precision-guaranteed one.
